changelog: Say "translate to English" or "translate to Bengali" — or "translate it" / "অনুবাদ করো" in Bengali for the other language — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the whole dictated message is translated in one pass through Gemini with your own key. The whole-message translate Gboard never had: Gboard's Translate only works live, segment by segment, and only when translate mode is on before dictating. Keeps every fact, name and number and your meaning; names are transliterated into the target script.
